text: The README enumerates the stable top-level command surface: `init`, `sync`, `verify`, `replay`, `status`, `export`, `explain`, `drift`, `mcp-server`, `optimize prompts`, `autopilot init|disable`, `daemon install|start|stop|status|run`, `schema`, and `describe <command>`; it also states that every top-level command supports `--help` and calls out `og schema`, `og describe sync`, and `og describe daemon status` as machine bootstrap entrypoints.
